title: Yellowed Golden Norwegian Cheese Frittata
description: A Norwegian-inspired brunch dish featuring a golden cheese frittata with herbal notes and a crunchy toffee popcorn topping, perfect for a shojin-friendly meal. This recipe is kneaded to perfection and offers a delightful cheese-pull experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until well combined.
Add the shredded norwegian cheese to the bowl and stir until the cheese is fully incorporated.
Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Sprinkle the crushed toffee popcorn and chopped parsley over the top of the frittata.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the eggs are almost set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Slide the frittata onto a plate and serve warm.
